candidate_sentence_map.S1: AS Trigon Property Development reported a significant deterioration in performance in 2025 compared with 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: The company generated no property sales revenue during the year, compared with €331,920 in 2024, when two land transactions were completed.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: As a result, gross profit fell from €220,299 to zero and the operating result changed from a profit of €161,649 to a loss of €108,021.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: Administrative and general expenses increased 70% to €108,021 from €63,650, including €41,452 of remuneration paid to management and supervisory board members, compared with no such expense in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Financial income rose to €8,513 from €5,760, but this was insufficient to offset operating costs.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: The company recorded a net loss of €99,507 for 2025, compared with a net profit of €167,409 in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Fourth-quarter results also weakened sharply: the company posted a net loss of €23,333, versus a net profit of €154,215 in the fourth quarter of 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Basic and diluted earnings per share declined from €0.03721 to negative €0.02212.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: At year-end, total assets decreased 3.7% to €1.805 million from €1.874 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Cash declined to €227,911 from €370,856, reflecting operating cash outflows of €142,945, compared with positive operating cash flow of €194,723 in 2024.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Inventories increased to €1.563 million from €1.471 million, primarily because €91,262 was invested in the Pärnu property development project.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Total liabilities increased to €49,389 from €18,906, while equity fell 5.4% to €1.755 million as a result of the annual loss.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: The company continues to own a single 13.2-hectare development project in Pärnu, Estonia, intended for commercial, industrial and logistics uses.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Its stated strategy remains the sale of existing land plots, with no plans to begin a new business activity in the following year.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: The company did not complete any land sales in 2025, in contrast to the 0.09-hectare sale for €31,920 in the third quarter of 2024 and the 0.70-hectare sale for €300,000 in the fourth quarter.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: The share price increased modestly from €0.620 to €0.634 during 2025, raising market capitalisation from €2.789 million to €2.852 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: However, book value per share declined from €0.41 to €0.39, and return on assets and return on equity changed from positive 8.93% and 9.03% to negative 5.51% and 5.67%, respectively.

evaluation.label: Generally yes
evaluation.justification: K1, K2, K3, K4, K5, and K8 are all PRESENT with supporting sentences identified. K6 and K7 are MISSING entirely – there is no mention of the planning amendment or shareholder structure changes. Despite two HIGH importance items missing, the majority of HIGH importance criteria are covered, and the main picture of financial deterioration is captured. This places the summary in the 'Generally yes' category.
